# Ande Mafenuka

> Where African fashion research meets the shoot.

Ande Mafenuka, known as Samba, is a wardrobe stylist working between Cape Town and Johannesburg, South Africa. He styles editorial, campaign and music-video shoots for fashion publications, brands and cultural institutions, including The Market Theatre Foundation and Vogue. His credited work covers menswear tailoring, occasion dressing, athleisure, and archival and folk dress. He also works as a designer and creative researcher, and has taken modelling and direction credits on his own editorial projects.

## Services

- Wardrobe Styling: Wardrobe sourcing, fitting and styling for shoots, from concept through to shoot day.
- Editorial Styling: Styling for magazine and publication editorials, including concept and garment sourcing.
- Campaign Styling: Styling for brand campaigns and commercial shoots.
- E-commerce Styling: Garment styling for e-commerce and lookbook photography.
- Creative Direction: Shoot concept, references and visual direction alongside photographer and client.
- Fashion Research: Cultural and archival garment research used to build shoot references and looks.

## Specialisms

- Menswear tailoring
- Occasion dressing
- Athleisure and fitness wear
- Archival and folk dress
- African-print textiles
- Editorial styling
- Music video styling
- Mannequin installation
